posts.en:
dsh-rule-engine is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Rules execution engine for dsh: parses AGENTS.md, hard-blocks rule-violating tool calls, text-based B/D rule auditing, /guard command, version-guard for versioned files, and free-zone support (engine skips free-zone sections).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-8bd18d323ccdd76349d8.html
